issues.title: [Epic · Week 4] Synthetic encyclopedia templates and prototype completion
issues.outcome: Complete the remaining reusable encyclopedia templates and prepare a reviewable prototype package without integrating real Arcaea content.
scope: Demonstrate spoiler, long-form, relationships, and generic topic patterns.
Prepare screenshots, route inventory, field inventory, and exclusions for lowiro.
acceptanceCriteria: Character, story, and topic templates work with synthetic records.
No real Arcaea content is present.
Prototype package clearly describes intended future scope.
The UI is ready for later approved data mapping.
definitionOfDone: Relevant documentation and tests are updated.
No unreviewed legal, accessibility, security, performance, privacy, or publication exception is introduced.

issues.title: [Week 4 · Feature] Synthetic character index and detail experience
issues.outcome: Build reusable character index/detail templates with invented records, original placeholders, status, spoilers, and related links.
scope: Index/detail templates, aliases, synthetic facts, summary distinction, spoiler state, missing media, and relationships.
acceptanceCriteria: Only project-authored or licensed synthetic images are used.
definitionOfDone: Relevant documentation and tests are updated.
No unreviewed legal, accessibility, security, performance, privacy, or publication exception is introduced.

issues.title: [Week 4 · Feature] Synthetic story index, chronology, and spoiler-aware content templates
issues.outcome: Build accessible story taxonomy and long-form templates using wholly original synthetic prose.
scope: Story ordering, index/detail templates, spoiler disclosure, original summaries, relationships, typography, and contents navigation.
acceptanceCriteria: No official or community story text/translation is reproduced.
Spoiler controls work by keyboard and assistive technology.
Long pages remain readable and performant.
definitionOfDone: Relevant documentation and tests are updated.
No unreviewed legal, accessibility, security, performance, privacy, or publication exception is introduced.

issues.title: [Week 4 · Feature] Generic topic encyclopedia and information-hub templates
issues.outcome: Create reusable topic/index templates with synthetic mechanics and terminology, ready to map approved Arcaea topics later.
scope: Topic taxonomy, aliases, version applicability, source status, related links, and information hub.
Use invented mechanics rather than World Mode, Course Mode, or other real Arcaea-specific content before authorization.
acceptanceCriteria: Search indexes titles, aliases, and summaries.
definitionOfDone: Relevant documentation and tests are updated.
No unreviewed legal, accessibility, security, performance, privacy, or publication exception is introduced.
